
{{alias}}( container, token )
    Resolves a JSON Pointer reference token against a container.

    For arrays, the function returns an integer index. The '-' token is resolved
    to the array length. Invalid array indices throw an error.

    For objects, the function returns the token string as-is.

    Parameters
    ----------
    container: Object|Array
        Parent container.

    token: string
        JSON Pointer reference token.

    Returns
    -------
    key: string|integer
        Resolved key.

    Examples
    --------
    > var key = {{alias}}( [ 1, 2, 3 ], '0' )
    0
    > key = {{alias}}( [ 1, 2, 3 ], '-' )
    3
    > key = {{alias}}( { 'foo': 'bar' }, 'foo' )
    'foo'

    See Also
    --------
